## Motivation

Single-token BF16 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next decode launches separate HC combine/norm and MoE shared-gate/finalize/collective work, while the packed GDN value tile leaves substantial register pressure at this shape. On four B200 GPUs, this patch raises the measured 8k-input/1k-output decode rate from fresh stock **242.443** to **270.982–271.759 token/s**, preserving the sampled stock accuracy in four native runs.

## Modifications

- Overlap the HC gate with block computation, fuse HC apply with grouped Gemma RMSNorm, and pass the prepared norm tensors explicitly across layers. PLE and PP boundaries retain the normal handoff.
- Extend the existing collective with an FP32 shared gate, preserving routed BF16 rounding before the shared-expert FMA. Defer BF16 MoE finalize and overlap the shared branch through a guarded single-token TP4/EP1 path with its own communication buffer.
- Use the smaller GDN value tile for the packed single-token BF16/FP32-state Blackwell shape, preserving the one-warp reduction order. Existing dispatch remains for unsupported shapes.

The MoE specialization requires hidden size 2560, 512 experts/top-10, BF16, SM10, TP4/EP1, attention DP1, with LoRA, speculative decoding and two-batch overlap disabled. No extra command-line switch enables the kernels. The benchmark selects the existing faster custom-all-reduce deployment option for both stock and candidate.

## Accuracy Tests

Stock and all four native candidate runs score **126/128 GSM8K, zero invalid answers, zero truncations**. These use identical frozen tokenized prompts, normal EOS and the same 2,048-token cap. All 128 per-question correctness and finish-reason verdicts match the fresh stock run.

Historical GPU validation before the standalone test cleanup: 6 HC unit configurations; 12 independent torch-reference GDN configurations; 6 collective configurations on each of 4 ranks, including the original ungated API; 90 trained HC-chain comparisons; 324 changed-input trained collective graph comparisons; 192 seeded GDN output/state bit comparisons. Isolated HC memcheck: zero errors. Full-stack communicator checks have the same handled PyTorch FABRIC capability API errors in stock and candidate, so they are not claimed as clean full-stack sanitizer runs. Pre-commit passes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same four B200 GPUs; BF16 weights/KV/indexer, FP32 GDN state, TP4, GPU PLE, context 16384, concurrency one, no speculative decoding or prefix caching. Each speed run has 3 warmups + 32 measured requests. Rate is `1023 / mean(last_token_time - first_token_time)`; TTFT/E2E are retained separately. Profiling runs are separate.

| Run | Decode token/s | TTFT ms | E2E s | GSM8K | Truncated |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Fresh stock SGLang, custom AR | 242.443 | 140.04 | 4.3597 | 126/128 | 0 |
| Native candidate, initial validation | 271.032 | 141.60 | 3.9162 | 126/128 | 0 |
| Pair 1, sglang | 271.759 | 141.33 | 3.9058 | 126/128 | 0 |
| Pair 1, vllm | 236.285 | 122.56 | 4.4522 | 125/128 | 1 |
| Pair 2, sglang | 271.229 | 141.02 | 3.9128 | 126/128 | 0 |
| Pair 2, vllm | 236.591 | 123.40 | 4.4475 | 126/128 | 0 |
| Pair 3, sglang | 270.982 | 141.45 | 3.9167 | 126/128 | 0 |
| Pair 3, vllm | 236.265 | 122.46 | 4.4525 | 126/128 | 0 |

Raw paired speed ratios: 1.150134x, 1.146404x, 1.146941x. Against the fastest observed GPU-PLE vLLM result (240.786 token/s), even the slowest native candidate is **12.54% faster**. That conservative denominator includes the quality-failing EP4 result. vLLM's first final TP4 repeat also has one truncation and remains a failed quality observation; this comparison does **not** establish stable quality parity for vLLM. CPU-offloaded PLE trials are excluded from the matched comparison. GPU-PLE CUTLASS and Triton trials are included in the deployment-search data.

Stock has 1,432 kernels per decode graph. All four candidate traces have 1,241 per graph, including 95 HC apply/norm, 48 gated finalize/all-reduce and 36 packed GDN calls. Kernel sums overlap through PDL and are not critical-path latency. The pinned sources, portable commands, workload hashes, all request timings/verdicts, deployment search, layer guides and NCU evidence are in the [reproducer](https://gist.github.com/BBuf/230ee2c4459828f6edeb76caa7e8dd33). The results apply to the measured text-decode workload.

SGLang base `f03a183719c9e7fb2bd528ed5c7e3b627d9df92d`, measured head `b66c816cf6475dbaec3e1b5d2d68a3f8c0d77ab1`; vLLM `b538d807ffe0976af7e5d107ccfe77e676b83b70`. Model revision `de4b8e4d43b917e7706784d8bb445c9af86a3540`.

- [x] Format with pre-commit.
- [x] Retain layer-boundary correctness tests.
- [x] Document specialization guards and provide portable reproduction instructions.
- [x] Provide accuracy, speed and profiling evidence.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

+"""Separate HC gate preparation and combine, with optional next-branch norm.
+
+The decode specialization accepts four branches of 2560 BF16 values. Gate
+partials belong to each invocation, so overlapping sublayers never reuse them.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_module():
+    return load_jit(
+        "hc_combine_decode",
+        cuda_files=["elementwise/hc_combine_decode.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            ("gate", "HcCombineDecode::gate"),
+            ("apply", "HcCombineDecode::apply"),
+            ("apply_norm", "HcCombineNormDecode<2>::run"),
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def hc_combine_gate(normed: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    partials = torch.empty(
+        (normed.shape[0], 8, 4), device=normed.device, dtype=torch.float32
+    )
+    _jit_module().gate(normed, weight, partials)
+    return partials
+

+def hc_combine_apply(
+    block: torch.Tensor, residual: torch.Tensor, partials: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    combined = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    _jit_module().apply(block, residual, partials, combined)
+    return combined

+    block: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,

+    normalized = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    _jit_module().apply_norm(

+    )
+    return combined, normalized
